api_sessions_app_scope.name: api_sessions_app_scope
api_sessions_app_scope.value: ('app' = ANY(scopes)) = (user_id IS NOT NULL AND device_id IS NOT NULL)

users_attested_at.name: users_attested_at
users_attested_at.value: NOT age_attested_18plus OR attested_at IS NOT NULL

users_wallet_required.name: users_wallet_required
users_wallet_required.value: is_demo OR deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR wallet_pubkey IS NOT NULL

rooms_expiry.name: rooms_expiry
rooms_expiry.value: expires_at > created_at AND expires_at <= created_at + interval '14 days'

bets_stake_a_cap.name: bets_stake_a_cap
bets_stake_a_cap.value: stake_a IS NULL OR stake_a BETWEEN 1 AND 20000000

bets_stake_b_cap.name: bets_stake_b_cap
bets_stake_b_cap.value: stake_b IS NULL OR stake_b BETWEEN 1 AND 20000000

bets_binding_set.name: bets_binding_set
bets_binding_set.value:
state < 'AWAITING_AUTHORIZATIONS' OR state IN ('CANCELLED','EXPIRED')
        OR (terms_hash IS NOT NULL AND stake_a IS NOT NULL AND stake_b IS NOT NULL AND evidence_source IS NOT NULL)

bets_onchain_binding.name: bets_onchain_binding
bets_onchain_binding.value:
onchain_status = 'none'
        OR (terms_hash IS NOT NULL AND stake_a IS NOT NULL AND stake_b IS NOT NULL)

bets_wallet_snapshot.name: bets_wallet_snapshot
bets_wallet_snapshot.value: is_seed OR onchain_status = 'none' OR party_a_wallet IS NOT NULL

bets_auth_pairs.name: bets_auth_pairs
bets_auth_pairs.value:
(a_authorized_at IS NULL) = (a_authorization_method IS NULL)
        AND (b_authorized_at IS NULL) = (b_authorization_method IS NULL)

bets_locked_authorized.name: bets_locked_authorized
bets_locked_authorized.value:
is_seed OR onchain_status IN ('none','open','cancelled')
        OR (onchain_status = 'refunded' AND accept_sig IS NULL)
        OR (a_authorized_at IS NOT NULL AND b_authorized_at IS NOT NULL)

bets_refusal.name: bets_refusal
bets_refusal.value: (end_reason IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'refused') = (refusal_category IS NOT NULL)

bets_terminal_sig.name: bets_terminal_sig
bets_terminal_sig.value: is_seed OR onchain_status < 'settled' OR payout_sig IS NOT NULL

bets_payout_rule.name: bets_payout_rule
bets_payout_rule.value:
onchain_status < 'settled' OR (
        outcome IS NOT NULL AND payout_a IS NOT NULL AND payout_b IS NOT NULL
        AND CASE onchain_status
          WHEN 'cancelled' THEN payout_b = 0 AND payout_a >= stake_a
          WHEN 'refunded'  THEN (payout_b = 0 AND payout_a >= stake_a)
                             OR (payout_a = stake_a AND payout_b >= stake_b)
          ELSE payout_a + payout_b >= stake_a + stake_b AND CASE outcome
            WHEN 'party_a' THEN payout_b = 0
            WHEN 'party_b' THEN payout_a = 0
            WHEN 'refund'  THEN payout_a = stake_a
            WHEN 'split'   THEN payout_a = (payout_a + payout_b) / 2
          END
        END)

bets_gemini_market.name: bets_gemini_market
bets_gemini_market.value:
evidence_source IS DISTINCT FROM 'gemini'
        OR (gemini_market_id IS NOT NULL AND a_position IS NOT NULL
            AND outcome IS DISTINCT FROM 'split')

bets_odds_source.name: bets_odds_source
bets_odds_source.value: odds_source IS NULL OR odds_source IN ('mid','last_in_spread')

bets_odds_p_range.name: bets_odds_p_range
bets_odds_p_range.value: odds_p IS NULL OR odds_p BETWEEN 0 AND 1

bets_payout_nonneg.name: bets_payout_nonneg
bets_payout_nonneg.value: (payout_a IS NULL OR payout_a >= 0) AND (payout_b IS NULL OR payout_b >= 0)

voice_sessions_bet_bound.name: voice_sessions_bet_bound
voice_sessions_bet_bound.value: bet_id IS NOT NULL OR status = 'active'

chain_txs_message_sha.name: chain_txs_message_sha
chain_txs_message_sha.value: message_b64 IS NULL OR message_sha256 = encode(sha256(decode(message_b64, 'base64')), 'hex')

chain_txs_lock_shape.name: chain_txs_lock_shape
chain_txs_lock_shape.value:
kind <> 'atomic_lock' OR (message_b64 IS NOT NULL AND nonce_account IS NOT NULL
        AND nonce_value IS NOT NULL AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND signer_role = 'both_parties')

chain_txs_lock_fully_signed.name: chain_txs_lock_fully_signed
chain_txs_lock_fully_signed.value:
kind <> 'atomic_lock' OR status NOT IN ('sent','confirmed')
        OR (a_signature IS NOT NULL AND b_signature IS NOT NULL)

chain_txs_nonce_advance_shape.name: chain_txs_nonce_advance_shape
chain_txs_nonce_advance_shape.value: kind <> 'nonce_advance' OR (nonce_account IS NOT NULL AND signer_role = 'fee_payer')

chain_txs_first_signer.name: chain_txs_first_signer
chain_txs_first_signer.value: (first_signer IS NULL) = (a_signature IS NULL AND b_signature IS NULL)

chain_txs_cu.name: chain_txs_cu
chain_txs_cu.value: cu_limit IS NULL OR simulated_cu IS NULL OR cu_limit >= simulated_cu

nonce_pool_leased.name: nonce_pool_leased
nonce_pool_leased.value: (status = 'leased') = (leased_bet_id IS NOT NULL AND leased_tx_id IS NOT NULL)

nonce_pool_free_value.name: nonce_pool_free_value
nonce_pool_free_value.value: status <> 'free' OR nonce_value IS NOT NULL

appeal_votes_failed.name: appeal_votes_failed
appeal_votes_failed.value:
status = 'ok' OR (outcome = 'REDO' AND confidence = 0 AND reason = ''
        AND counted_as = 'ABSTAIN')

appeals_final_outcome.name: appeals_final_outcome
appeals_final_outcome.value: final_outcome IS NULL OR final_outcome IN ('A_WINS','B_WINS','VOID')

appeals_decided.name: appeals_decided
appeals_decided.value:
(status = 'decided') = (decided_at IS NOT NULL AND final_outcome IS NOT NULL
        AND decided_by IS NOT NULL AND flipped IS NOT NULL AND result_ruling_id IS NOT NULL)

appeals_flipped.name: appeals_flipped
appeals_flipped.value: flipped IS NULL OR flipped = (final_outcome IS DISTINCT FROM original_outcome)

attempts_clip_mime.name: attempts_clip_mime
attempts_clip_mime.value: clip_mime IS NULL OR clip_mime IN ('video/mp4','video/quicktime')

attempts_clip_bytes.name: attempts_clip_bytes
attempts_clip_bytes.value: clip_bytes IS NULL OR clip_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 26214400

attempts_duration.name: attempts_duration
attempts_duration.value: duration_ms IS NULL OR duration_ms BETWEEN 1 AND 30000

attempts_frames.name: attempts_frames
attempts_frames.value:
cardinality(frame_ts_ms) = cardinality(frame_hashes) AND cardinality(frame_hashes) <= 24
        AND (cardinality(frame_keys) = 0 OR cardinality(frame_keys) = cardinality(frame_hashes))

rulings_confidence.name: rulings_confidence
rulings_confidence.value: confidence IS NULL OR confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1

rulings_onchain_ix.name: rulings_onchain_ix
rulings_onchain_ix.value: onchain_ix IS NULL OR (onchain_ix IN ('resolve','resolve_appeal') AND outcome <> 'REDO')

gemini_markets_settlement_hash.name: gemini_markets_settlement_hash
gemini_markets_settlement_hash.value:
settlement_raw IS NULL
        OR settlement_response_sha256 = encode(sha256(convert_to(settlement_raw, 'UTF8')), 'hex')

market_snapshots_hash.name: market_snapshots_hash
market_snapshots_hash.value:
(snapshot_canonical IS NULL) = (snapshot_sha256 IS NULL)
        AND (snapshot_canonical IS NULL
          OR snapshot_sha256 = encode(sha256(convert_to(snapshot_canonical, 'UTF8')), 'hex'))
